verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents that UCP-capable agents can connect to its catalog for product search and lookup. Its API is under a v1 path and returns a consistent product schema across retailers. That is a real but thin tie to a versioned commerce protocol, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec at common paths. Missing for 10: published machine-readable protocol/API schema, explicit protocol versioning documentation, conformance or validation tooling, and coverage of checkout flows beyond search and lookup.
